overview: The backend API (todo-api) has no dependencies and must be built first, as it defines the data contracts and authentication mechanisms the frontend relies on. The frontend (todo-web) depends entirely on todo-api being available for its API shape, JWT flow, and endpoint URLs, so it is implemented second. This bottom-up ordering ensures the SPA is developed against a stable, tested API contract rather than mocked assumptions.

phases.name: Foundation Services
phases.description: The Go REST API is the sole foundation component with no upstream dependencies. It owns all data persistence, authentication, and business logic, and must be fully implemented and verified before the frontend can be meaningfully developed.

components.name: todo-api
responsibilities: Authenticate users via JWT-based sessions, including registration, login, logout, and password reset flows
Enforce per-user data isolation for all task and category reads, writes, and deletes
Manage full CRUD lifecycle for tasks (with title/description/due-date/category/completion state) and categories
Compute and expose derived task state (overdue flag) and support dynamic list filtering, sorting, and keyword search
Run embedded SQL migrations on startup and maintain the PostgreSQL schema
components.architectureContext: This is the only stateful backend service in the system. It is called exclusively by todo-web over HTTPS using Bearer JWT tokens. It connects to a PostgreSQL database (external to this component) and an SMTP server for password reset emails. No other service depends on it at the infrastructure level, but todo-web cannot function without it. It exposes a /health endpoint for Kubernetes liveness probes.
keyConsiderations: JWT sessions must be stored in the sessions table (token_hash = sha256(raw_token)) so that logout can hard-invalidate tokens server-side — stateless JWT verification alone is insufficient.

Dynamic SQL query construction for GET /tasks (filters + sort) must always include AND user_id = $1 as the base predicate to prevent cross-user data leakage; use a query-builder pattern rather than string concatenation to avoid SQL injection.
Password reset tokens must always return 204 regardless of whether the email exists to prevent user enumeration; the token hash (sha256) is stored, never the raw token.

Bcrypt cost 12 is intentionally slow — ensure the /auth/register and /auth/login handlers do not block the Go HTTP server's goroutine pool under the 500-concurrent-user load target; consider a semaphore to cap simultaneous bcrypt operations.

The overdue computed field must use CURRENT_DATE (database server time) not application server time to stay consistent across horizontal replicas, and NULL due_date rows must never be flagged overdue.
components.apiContract:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Todo API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9090
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      operationId: healthCheck
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: { type: string, example: ok }

  /auth/register:
    post:
      summary: Register a new user
      operationId: registerUser
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email: { type: string, format: email }
                password: { type: string, minLength: 8 }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '409': { description: Email already registered }

  /auth/login:
    post:
      summary: Log in
      operationId: loginUser
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email: { type: string, format: email }
                password: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Logged in
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '401': { description: Invalid credentials }

  /auth/logout:
    post:
      summary: Log out (invalidate token)
      operationId: logoutUser
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204': { description: Logged out }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }

  /auth/password-reset/request:
    post:
      summary: Request a password reset email
      operationId: requestPasswordReset
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email]
              properties:
                email: { type: string, format: email }
      responses:
        '204': { description: Reset email sent (or silently ignored if email unknown) }

  /auth/password-reset/confirm:
    post:
      summary: Confirm password reset with token
      operationId: confirmPasswordReset
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [token, new_password]
              properties:
                token: { type: string }
                new_password: { type: string, minLength: 8 }
      responses:
        '204': { description: Password updated }
        '400': { description: Invalid or expired token }

  /categories:
    get:
      summary: List all categories for the authenticated user
      operationId: listCategories
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of categories
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
    post:
      summary: Create a new category
      operationId: createCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [name]
              properties:
                name: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 50 }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Category created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }

  /categories/{categoryId}:
    parameters:
      - name: categoryId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    put:
      summary: Rename a category
      operationId: updateCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [name]
              properties:
                name: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 50 }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated category
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Category not found }
    delete:
      summary: Delete a category (tasks become uncategorized)
      operationId: deleteCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204': { description: Deleted }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Category not found }

  /tasks:
    get:
      summary: List tasks with optional filters and sorting
      operationId: listTasks
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema: { type: string, enum: [all, active, completed], default: all }
        - name: category_id
          in: query
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - name: overdue
          in: query
          schema: { type: boolean }
        - name: q
          in: query
          description: Keyword search against title and description
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: sort
          in: query
          schema: { type: string, enum: [due_date_asc, due_date_desc, created_at_asc, created_at_desc], default: due_date_asc }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of tasks
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
    post:
      summary: Create a new task
      operationId: createTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskInput'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Task created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }

  /tasks/{taskId}:
    parameters:
      - name: taskId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    get:
      summary: Get a single task
      operationId: getTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Task not found }
    put:
      summary: Update a task
      operationId: updateTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskInput'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Task not found }
    delete:
      summary: Delete a task permanently
      operationId: deleteTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204': { description: Deleted }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Task not found }

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  schemas:
    AuthResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        token: { type: string }
        expires_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        user:
          type: object
          properties:
            id: { type: string, format: uuid }
            email: { type: string, format: email }
    Category:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        name: { type: string }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        updated_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
    Task:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        title: { type: string }
        description: { type: string, nullable: true }
        completed: { type: boolean }
        due_date: { type: string, format: date, nullable: true }
        overdue: { type: boolean, description: Computed; true when due_date is past and completed is false }
        category_id: { type: string, format: uuid, nullable: true }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        updated_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
    TaskInput:
      type: object
      required: [title]
      properties:
        title: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 255 }
        description: { type: string, maxLength: 2000, nullable: true }
        completed: { type: boolean, default: false }
        due_date: { type: string, format: date, nullable: true }
        category_id: { type: string, format: uuid, nullable: true }

phases.name: Frontend Application
phases.description: The React SPA can only be built after the API is established, as it depends on the live API contract for typed client generation, authentication flow integration, and end-to-end feature verification. VITE_API_BASE_URL must point to the Phase 1 service.

components.name: todo-web
responsibilities: Provide authenticated user flows for registration, login, logout, and password reset via the todo-api auth endpoints
Render and manage the full task lifecycle — creation, editing, completion toggling, deletion with confirmation, and display of overdue state
Enable category management (create, rename, delete) with real-time UI updates via React Query cache invalidation
Apply client-side filtering UI (status, category, overdue, keyword search, sort) that maps directly to todo-api query parameters
Serve as a static SPA via nginx with SPA fallback routing, health check, gzip compression, and HTTPS-ready configuration
components.architectureContext: todo-web is the only user-facing component in the system. It makes all HTTP requests exclusively to todo-api using Axios with a JWT Bearer token interceptor. It has no backend of its own — nginx serves only static files and a stub /health endpoint. It depends on todo-api being reachable at the URL provided by the VITE_API_BASE_URL build argument. On 401 responses from todo-api, it clears localStorage and redirects to /login.
keyConsiderations: VITE_API_BASE_URL is baked into the static bundle at Docker build time via an ARG — if the API URL changes post-build, the image must be rebuilt; consider runtime environment injection via a small entrypoint script writing a window.ENV config if URL flexibility is needed.

The 300 ms debounced search input must cancel in-flight React Query requests on each keystroke to avoid stale results overtaking fresh ones; use React Query's enabled flag or AbortController via Axios cancelToken.

All Radix UI Dialog and AlertDialog usage must ensure focus is trapped within the modal and restored to the triggering element on close — this is handled by Radix primitives but custom overlays must not break the focus chain.

JWT is stored in localStorage, which is vulnerable to XSS; ensure no user-supplied content is rendered as raw HTML (use React's default JSX escaping), and apply a strict Content-Security-Policy header in nginx.conf.

Route-level code splitting via React.lazy + Suspense must provide meaningful loading fallbacks to avoid blank screens on slow connections, and the nginx try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html rule is critical to prevent 404s on direct URL access or refresh.
components.apiContract:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Todo Web App (static)
  version: 1.0.0
  description: This component is a static SPA served by nginx. It has no REST API of its own. The single health endpoint is served by the nginx container.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:3000
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      operationId: healthCheck
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: { type: string, example: ok }
